description: The bar chart illustrates the performance of different models and strategies across three metrics: EGP, TR-N, and CCP, with performance values ranging from 0.0 to 1.0 on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis lists the metrics, each accompanied by an upward (↑) or downward (↓) arrow indicating the direction of optimization. Four model configurations are compared: Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), RPG (CodeLlama-7B), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and RPG (CodeLlama-34B), represented by blue, orange, green, and red bars, respectively. For the EGP metric, the RPG (CodeLlama-7B) model achieves the highest performance at approximately 0.9, followed by Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) at around 0.6, while the Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) models show lower performance, with the latter reaching about 0.9. In the TR-N metric, the Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) model performs best at approximately 0.7, followed by Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) at around 0.6, while RPG (CodeLlama-7B) and RPG (CodeLlama-34B) achieve lower performance, with the latter at about 0.4. For the CCP metric, the RPG (CodeLlama-34B) model achieves the highest performance at approximately 0.95, followed by RPG (CodeLlama-7B) at around 0.72, while Greedy (CodeLlama-7B) and Greedy (CodeLlama-34B) show lower performance, with the former at about 0.4 and the latter at around 0.7. The chart highlights that the performance varies significantly across different metrics and model configurations, with RPG (CodeLlama-34B) showing the highest performance in CCP, and RPG (CodeLlama-7B) showing the highest performance in EGP.
